title: Harvest Record Form
subtitle: Harvest Record: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Harvest Record Form covers crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff. The harvest operations owner records Harvest Record activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Harvest Record Form keeps Harvest Record exceptions visible until the harvest operations owner handoff.
use_case: Use Harvest Record Form at field, block, harvest zone, loading point, and receiving or cooling location. Document crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff identity before Harvest Record begins. Compare crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff findings with stated Harvest Record criteria; route unresolved Harvest Record issues to farm production reviewer.

sections.title: Task record and responsible parties
sections.guidance: For Harvest Record, identify responsible parties, field, block, harvest zone, loading point, and receiving or cooling location, and the linked crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff source.

fields.label: Farm, field, block, crop, and variety
Harvest date, crew, supervisor, and lot
Container, trailer, load, quantity, and destination

sections.title: Recorded quantities, results, and controls
sections.guidance: Capture Harvest Record facts for crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Harvest Record operating checks
items: Crew, tool, container, and hygiene readiness
Transport, cooling, receiving, rejection, and loss

sections.title: Retained evidence and next operating action
sections.guidance: Resolve open Harvest Record conditions; have harvest operations owner assign the next Harvest Record owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Harvest Record when lot identity, crop condition, quantity, cooling, or receiving custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Harvest Record proof and route unresolved crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff scope to harvest operations owner.
